sloka: वर आयुध धरौ वीरौ कस्य पुत्रौ महामुने ।भूषयन्तौ इमम् देशम् चन्द्र सूर्यौ इव अंबरम् ॥१-५०-२०॥
transliteration: vara āyudha dharau vīrau kasya putrau mahāmune ।bhūṣayantau imam deśam candra sūryau iva aṁbaram ॥1-50-20॥

translations.english: Great ascetic, these two young men with hair falling on their temples like the wings of a crow, each of them resemble the other in personality, expressions and gestures. Wielding excellent weapons they adorn this land like the Moon and the Sun deck the sky. Whose sons are they? I wish truly to hear about these heroes".
translations.hindi: हे -घुनन्द्रन ! मुनिवेष धारण किए हुए इन्द्र को पहिचान कर भी, दुष्टा अहल्या ने प्रसन्नतापूर्जक इन्द्र के साथ भोग किया
